tasks.title: Unify context entrypoints
tasks.acceptance: Small entrypoints point to one runbook; read current state plus active track rather than loading historical reports.

tasks.title: Maintain decision and uncertainty records
tasks.acceptance: Record scope, Polars interpretation, uncertainty, source trust, latest-target versus installed status and all remaining blockers.

tasks.title: Align CI with local gates
tasks.acceptance: Same local gates, frozen environments, read-only permissions, full Git history, SHA-pinned Actions and bounded artifact retention. Hosted execution remains unverified.
tasks.blocker: External DNS/tool installation or hosted execution is unavailable

tasks.title: Guard releases
tasks.acceptance: No bypass flag, automatic publication or partial-pass promotion. Release workflow calls the same CI and deliberately does not deploy.

tasks.title: Validate context and workflow structure
tasks.acceptance: Context paths/action pins and unsafe bypasses checked; dependency updates are explicit reviewable PRs, not silent auto-merge.

tasks.title: Attempt submodule materialisation
tasks.acceptance: Current upstream main rechecked and matches the existing pin. The actual checkout attempt failed on github.com DNS; no Conductor CLI run is claimed.
tasks.blocker: External DNS/tool installation or hosted execution is unavailable

tasks.title: Record handoff
tasks.acceptance: Handoff identifies the connected dependency-install acceptance task; authoring, economic validity and hosted execution remain separate.
